findings.summary: service.ts imports db client and schema directly; violates ARCHITECTURE §2.3 (repo.ts is the only db-touching file in a module).
findings.suggested_fix: Add findUserById(id) to apps/api/src/modules/auth/repo.ts (citext-safe, soft-delete-filtered). Replace the two inline db.select sites in service.ts refresh() and me() with authRepo.findUserById(...). Drop the db/schema imports and the file-level deviation comment. Requires scope extension (repo.ts not in task-auth-service.target_files).

findings.summary: service.ts imports the eagerly-loaded env singleton for JWT_SECRET/SESSION_TTL/REFRESH_TTL instead of taking them via DI.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend AuthServiceDeps with `config: { jwtSecret: string; sessionTtl: number; refreshTtl: number }` and read JWT_SECRET/SESSION_TTL/REFRESH_TTL from there; let composition root (buildApp/main) read env once and inject. Unblocks future buildApp DI wave and lets unit tests avoid setting JWT_SECRET in process.env before import.

findings.summary: JWT_SECRET defaults to 'change-me' (9 chars); env validator requires ≥32 bytes so api crash-loops on `docker compose up` without operator override.
findings.suggested_fix: Either drop the :- default so compose fails fast with a clearer message (e.g. `JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:?must be set, min 32 bytes}`) or ship a 32+ byte placeholder default in compose. Update .env.example to a 32+ byte placeholder in either case for one-shot demo runs.

findings.summary: POSTGRES_PASSWORD defaults to 'change-me' in compose and .env.example; weak default tolerable for PoC but invites copy-paste leakage.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set in .env}` to force operator to populate, or document the deliberate dev-only default in README. Acceptable as-is for the PoC scope per ARCHITECTURE §1.

findings.summary: migrate-stage CMD duplicates compose api-migrate.command verbatim; drift risk if one changes without the other.
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one source of truth: either rely on the Dockerfile CMD and drop `command:` from the compose api-migrate service, or keep `command:` in compose and remove the migrate CMD (still useful for `docker run` ad-hoc).
